work.title: Sticker Door
work.description: A red door divided into upper and lower panels: dense saturated stickers crowd the upper window — 'CODEFC', 'METRO', 'OLE', 'ABOVE' tags layered to white-out. Below, a stenciled black-line face with a red ankh, a small black tuxedoed figure, and the painted phrase 'ALONE' frame the lower glass.
work.composition: two-panel red door with stickers above, stencil below
